component.name: omatrimio
component.summary: A Stremio-compatible media center with the Omarchy look

description.p: omatrimio marries Stremio and Omarchy: Stremio's catalogs, addons, library, and player, following the Omarchy theme live, with Omarchy's icons, corners, and font, and no header bar.

omatrimio is an unofficial, community-made client. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or supported by Stremio or Smart Code OOD. It is a fork of stremio-linux-shell and loads the Stremio web app.
